en: The image depicts a vintage port scene, with a view over a harbor lined with small boats and piers. There are several buildings, sailing ships, and a lighthouse visible towards the horizon. The setting appears to be a small European coastal town, likely from the early 20th century. The text on the postcard is multilingual, written in German and Latvian, and names the location as a fishing harbor.
